description: This file defines the SmartyBC class, a backward compatibility wrapper for the Smarty template engine. It extends the Smarty class and provides method wrappers to support legacy function names and features from older Smarty versions, facilitating compatibility for projects using an earlier version of Smarty.

classes.name: SmartyBC
classes.description: A wrapper class providing backward compatibility for older versions of Smarty by extending the main Smarty class and adding method wrappers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new SmartyBC object by calling the parent Smarty constructor.

methods.name: assign_by_ref
methods.description: Wraps Smarty's assignByRef method to maintain legacy function naming.

methods.name: append_by_ref
methods.description: Wraps Smarty's appendByRef method for backward compatibility.

methods.name: clear_assign
methods.description: Wraps Smarty's clearAssign method to clear a template variable.

methods.name: register_function
methods.description: Registers a custom template function using Smarty's registerPlugin method.

methods.name: register_object
methods.description: Registers a PHP object to be used in templates.

methods.name: register_block
methods.description: Registers a block type plugin in Smarty.

methods.name: register_compiler_function
methods.description: Registers a compiler function for Smarty templates.

methods.name: register_modifier
methods.description: Registers a modifier for Smarty templates.

methods.name: register_resource
methods.description: Registers a resource type with handler functions.

methods.name: load_filter
methods.description: Loads a specified filter type and name.

methods.name: clear_cache
methods.description: Clears cache for a template or cache id.

methods.name: is_cached
methods.description: Checks whether a valid cache exists for a template.

methods.name: clear_compiled_tpl
methods.description: Clears the compiled version of a template.

methods.name: config_load
methods.description: Loads configuration values from a file.

methods.name: get_registered_object
methods.description: Returns a reference to a registered object.

methods.name: trigger_error
methods.description: Triggers a Smarty error with specified message and error type.
